zh.mech: 饮食不节、思虑过度损伤脾气，运化失职，水湿内停，气血生化不足。
zh.cause: 久坐少动、饮食不规律、思虑劳倦。
zh.cchar: 神疲乏力、气短懒言、易出汗，大便溏软。
zh.ctend: 易患感冒、内脏下垂、慢性疲劳。
zh.inquiry: 近一个月容易疲倦，饭后腹胀，大便偏稀，稍动就出汗。
zh.tongue: 舌淡胖，边有齿痕，苔白腻。
zh.summary: 综合问诊、舌象与脉象，患者以脾气虚为本、水湿内停为标。舌淡胖有齿痕、脉细弱均提示脾失健运。\n治疗以健脾益气、燥湿和中为主，配合规律饮食与温和运动，通常2至4周可见明显改善。
zh.rationale: 乏力便溏、舌淡胖齿痕、脉细弱三者互相印证脾气虚；苔白腻提示兼有湿阻。
avoid: 冰饮冷食 - 损伤脾阳
油腻甜腻 - 助湿生痰
生冷水果过量 - 加重便溏
recipes: 山药茯苓粥：山药50g、茯苓15g、粳米100g，煮粥早餐食用。
life: 饮食定时定量，细嚼慢咽
避免久坐，饭后散步20分钟
晚上11点前入睡以养脾气
points: 足三里 - 膝下三寸，按揉3分钟，健脾和胃
中脘 - 脐上四寸，顺时针摩腹，助运化
脾俞 - 背部第11胸椎旁，温灸10分钟
zh.emotion: 思伤脾，避免过度忧思，可通过听音乐、与朋友交流来舒缓。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
zh.note: 症状持续超过一个月请线下就诊排除其他疾病。
zh.fu_improve: 精神好转，大便成形，食欲改善
zh.fu_next: 按反应调整方药，逐步减少祛湿药味

en.mech: Irregular eating and overthinking weaken the Spleen's transformation, letting dampness accumulate while Qi and blood production falls.
en.cause: Sedentary habits, irregular meals, mental overwork.
en.cchar: Fatigue, shortness of breath, easy sweating, loose stools.
en.ctend: Prone to colds, prolapse-type weakness and chronic fatigue.
en.inquiry: Tired for the past month, bloated after meals, stools are loose and I sweat with little effort.
en.tongue: Pale, swollen tongue with teeth marks and a white greasy coat.
en.face: Sallow, lustreless complexion with pale lips.
en.audio: Low, weak voice with shortness of breath when speaking.
en.pulse: Thready and weak pulse, most marked at the right middle position.
en.summary: Taken together, the inquiry, tongue and pulse point to Spleen Qi deficiency as the root with internal dampness as the branch. The pale swollen tongue with teeth marks and the thready weak pulse both show impaired transformation and transportation.\nTreatment focuses on strengthening the Spleen, boosting Qi and resolving dampness, supported by regular meals and gentle exercise. Clear improvement is usually seen within 2 to 4 weeks.
en.rationale: Fatigue with loose stools, a swollen tongue with teeth marks and a thready weak pulse corroborate each other; the greasy coat adds a dampness component.
en.principle: Strengthen the Spleen, boost Qi, drain dampness
en.method: Tonify the middle burner, resolve dampness
good: Lotus seed - fortifies the Spleen and firms stools
Red dates - tonify the middle burner
avoid: Iced drinks and raw food - injure Spleen yang
Greasy or very sweet food - generates dampness
Excess raw fruit - worsens loose stools
recipes: Yam and poria congee: 50g yam, 15g poria, 100g rice, simmered into congee for breakfast.
life: Eat at regular times and chew slowly
Avoid prolonged sitting; walk 20 minutes after meals
Sleep before 11pm to support Spleen Qi
points: Zusanli (ST36) - below the knee, press 3 minutes to harmonise the stomach
Zhongwan (CV12) - clockwise abdominal massage to aid digestion
Pishu (BL20) - mild moxibustion for 10 minutes
exercise: Brisk walking, 4 times a week for 30 minutes
en.emotion: Overthinking injures the Spleen; relax with music, nature walks and talking to friends.
en.purpose: Strengthens the Spleen, drains dampness, stops diarrhoea
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Persistent abdominal pain or blood in stool
contra: Avoid cold, raw and greasy food
en.note: If symptoms last longer than a month, see a clinician to rule out other causes.
en.fu_improve: Better energy, formed stools, improved appetite
en.fu_next: Adjust the formula to response and gradually reduce dampness-draining herbs

ms.mech: Makan tidak teratur dan terlalu banyak berfikir melemahkan fungsi Limpa, menyebabkan kelembapan terkumpul dan penghasilan Qi serta darah berkurang.
ms.cause: Kurang bergerak, makan tidak teratur, keletihan mental.
ms.cchar: Letih, nafas pendek, mudah berpeluh, najis lembik.
ms.inquiry: Letih sejak sebulan lalu, perut kembung selepas makan, najis lembik dan mudah berpeluh.
ms.tongue: Lidah pucat dan bengkak dengan kesan gigi, salutan putih berminyak.
ms.face: Muka kekuningan tidak bermaya, bibir pucat.
ms.audio: Suara perlahan dan lemah, nafas pendek ketika bercakap.
ms.pulse: Nadi halus dan lemah, paling ketara di posisi kanan tengah.
ms.summary: Berdasarkan temu bual, lidah dan nadi, corak utama ialah kekurangan Qi Limpa dengan kelembapan dalaman. Lidah pucat bengkak dan nadi halus lemah menunjukkan fungsi pencernaan terjejas.\nRawatan menekankan penguatan Limpa, penambahan Qi dan penyingkiran kelembapan, bersama makan teratur dan senaman ringan. Peningkatan biasanya dilihat dalam 2 hingga 4 minggu.
ms.rationale: Keletihan dengan najis lembik, lidah bengkak berkesan gigi dan nadi lemah saling menyokong; salutan berminyak menunjukkan kelembapan.
ms.principle: Kuatkan Limpa, tambah Qi, singkir kelembapan
good: Ubi yam Cina - menguatkan Qi Limpa
avoid: Minuman ais dan makanan mentah - merosakkan yang Limpa
Makanan berminyak atau terlalu manis - menjana kelembapan
Buah mentah berlebihan - memburukkan najis lembik
recipes: Bubur yam dan poria: 50g yam, 15g poria, 100g beras, masak jadi bubur untuk sarapan.
life: Makan pada waktu tetap dan kunyah perlahan
Elak duduk lama; berjalan 20 minit selepas makan
Tidur sebelum 11 malam
points: Zusanli (ST36) - bawah lutut, urut 3 minit
Zhongwan (CV12) - urut perut ikut arah jam
Pishu (BL20) - moksibusi ringan 10 minit
ms.emotion: Terlalu banyak berfikir menjejaskan Limpa; bertenang dengan muzik dan berbual bersama rakan.
ms.formula: Shen Ling Bai Zhu San (diubah suai)
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Sakit perut berterusan atau najis berdarah
contra: Elak makanan sejuk, mentah dan berminyak
ms.note: Jika gejala melebihi sebulan, dapatkan pemeriksaan doktor.
ms.fu_improve: Tenaga bertambah, najis terbentuk, selera pulih

zh.mech: 情志不遂，肝失疏泄，气机郁结，横逆犯脾，故见胸胁胀闷与食欲波动。
zh.cause: 长期压力、情绪压抑、作息紧张。
zh.cchar: 情绪低落易叹息，胸胁胀闷，咽中有异物感。
zh.ctend: 易患失眠、抑郁倾向、乳房胀痛、月经不调。
zh.inquiry: 工作压力大，常觉胸闷想叹气，两胁胀，容易发脾气，经前乳房胀痛。
zh.summary: 患者因长期压力致肝气郁结，疏泄失常。胸胁胀闷、叹息、情绪易怒及弦脉均为典型肝郁表现，并有肝木乘脾之势。\n治以疏肝解郁、理气健脾，配合情志调摄与适度运动，一般3至4周可明显缓解。
zh.rationale: 胸胁胀、善太息、情绪波动与弦脉相符；舌边红提示郁而化热之趋势。
good: 玫瑰花茶 - 疏肝解郁
avoid: 咖啡浓茶 - 扰神助火
辛辣烧烤 - 助肝火
暴饮暴食 - 加重气滞
recipes: 玫瑰佛手茶：玫瑰花5朵、佛手6g，热水冲泡代茶饮。
life: 每天固定时间减压，如深呼吸或冥想
晚上11点前入睡，保证睡眠
与亲友倾诉，避免情绪积压
points: 太冲 - 足背第一二跖骨间，按揉3分钟，疏肝
膻中 - 两乳之间，轻揉，宽胸理气
期门 - 乳头直下第6肋间，按揉解胁胀
exercise: 户外慢跑或快走，每次30分钟
zh.emotion: 怒伤肝，学会适时表达情绪，可尝试写日记或听舒缓音乐。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
warn: 持续情绪低落并有轻生念头
zh.note: 如情绪问题明显影响生活，请同时寻求心理支持。
zh.fu_improve: 胸闷减轻，情绪平稳，经前不适改善
zh.fu_next: 根据情绪与睡眠调整疏肝药量

en.mech: Emotional strain impairs the Liver's free flow of Qi, which stagnates and invades the Spleen, causing chest and flank distension and fluctuating appetite.
en.cause: Prolonged stress, suppressed emotions, tense routines.
en.cchar: Low mood, frequent sighing, chest and flank distension, a lump-in-throat feeling.
en.ctend: Prone to insomnia, low mood, breast distension and irregular periods.
en.inquiry: High work stress, often feel chest tightness and need to sigh, flanks feel bloated, quick to lose my temper, breast tenderness before periods.
en.tongue: Slightly red edges with a thin white coat.
en.summary: Chronic stress has caused Liver Qi to stagnate and lose its smooth flow. Chest and flank distension, sighing, irritability and a wiry pulse are classic signs, with early Liver-over-Spleen tendency.\nTreatment soothes the Liver, regulates Qi and supports the Spleen, together with emotional care and moderate exercise. Marked relief is usually seen in 3 to 4 weeks.
en.rationale: Chest and flank distension, sighing and mood swings match the wiry pulse; red tongue edges hint at stagnation turning to heat.
en.principle: Soothe the Liver, relieve constraint, regulate Qi and fortify the Spleen
en.method: Spread Liver Qi, nourish blood and soften the Liver
good: Tangerine peel - regulates Qi and the stomach
Celery - clears Liver heat and irritability
avoid: Coffee and strong tea - agitate the spirit and add heat
Spicy and grilled food - inflame Liver fire
Binge eating - worsens Qi stagnation
recipes: Rose and finger citron tea: 5 rosebuds and 6g finger citron steeped in hot water.
life: Set a daily time to decompress with breathing or meditation
Sleep before 11pm
Talk to friends or family instead of bottling up stress
points: Taichong (LR3) - between the first and second toes, press 3 minutes to soothe the Liver
Shanzhong (CV17) - gentle circular massage to open the chest
Qimen (LR14) - press to relieve flank distension
exercise: Tai chi or yoga, 3 times a week
Outdoor jogging or brisk walking, 30 minutes
en.emotion: Anger injures the Liver; express feelings in healthy ways such as journaling or calming music.
en.purpose: Soothes the Liver, nourishes blood, fortifies the Spleen
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Persistent low mood with thoughts of self-harm
Chest pain that does not settle
contra: Avoid late nights and explosive anger
en.note: If mood symptoms disrupt daily life, please also seek psychological support.
en.fu_improve: Less chest tightness, steadier mood, easier periods
en.fu_next: Adjust Liver-soothing herbs according to mood and sleep

ms.mech: Tekanan emosi mengganggu aliran Qi Hati, lalu Qi bertakung dan menyerang Limpa sehingga dada dan rusuk terasa sendat serta selera tidak menentu.
ms.cause: Tekanan berpanjangan, emosi terpendam, rutin tegang.
ms.cchar: Murung, kerap mengeluh nafas, dada dan rusuk sendat.
ms.ctend: Mudah tidak boleh tidur, murung dan haid tidak teratur.
ms.inquiry: Tekanan kerja tinggi, dada sendat dan kerap mengeluh nafas, rusuk kembung, cepat marah, payudara sakit sebelum haid.
ms.tongue: Tepi lidah sedikit merah, salutan nipis putih.
ms.summary: Tekanan kronik menyebabkan Qi Hati bertakung. Dada dan rusuk sendat, mengeluh nafas, mudah marah dan nadi tegang ialah tanda tipikal, dengan kecenderungan Hati menyerang Limpa.\nRawatan melegakan Hati, mengatur Qi dan menyokong Limpa bersama penjagaan emosi dan senaman sederhana. Kelegaan jelas biasanya dalam 3 hingga 4 minggu.
ms.rationale: Rusuk kembung, mengeluh nafas dan emosi tidak stabil sepadan dengan nadi tegang; tepi lidah merah menunjukkan kecenderungan panas.
ms.principle: Lega Hati, atur Qi, kuatkan Limpa
avoid: Kopi dan teh pekat - mengganggu semangat
Makanan pedas dan bakar - menaikkan api Hati
Makan berlebihan - memburukkan genangan Qi
recipes: Teh ros dan sitron jari: 5 kuntum ros dan 6g sitron jari direndam dalam air panas.
life: Luangkan masa harian untuk bertenang, pernafasan atau meditasi
Tidur sebelum 11 malam
Berkongsi dengan keluarga atau rakan
points: Taichong (LR3) - antara jari kaki pertama dan kedua, urut 3 minit
Shanzhong (CV17) - urut bulat perlahan di dada
Qimen (LR14) - tekan untuk kurangkan rusuk sendat
exercise: Tai chi atau yoga 3 kali seminggu
ms.emotion: Kemarahan melukakan Hati; luahkan perasaan dengan sihat, contohnya menulis jurnal atau muzik menenangkan.
ms.purpose: Melegakan Hati, menambah darah, menguatkan Limpa
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Murung berterusan dengan fikiran mencederakan diri
contra: Elak berjaga malam dan marah melampau
ms.note: Jika emosi mengganggu kehidupan, dapatkan sokongan psikologi.
ms.fu_improve: Dada kurang sendat, emosi stabil, haid lebih selesa
ms.fu_next: Laras ubat melegakan Hati mengikut emosi dan tidur

zh.mech: 肾阴亏耗，水不制火，虚火内扰心神，故见盗汗、失眠、五心烦热。
zh.cchar: 口干咽燥，手足心热，盗汗，易烦躁。
zh.ctend: 易患失眠、便秘、更年期综合征。
zh.inquiry: 最近两周入睡困难，夜间盗汗，口干，手心发热，容易心烦。
zh.summary: 患者肾阴不足、虚火上扰，表现为失眠盗汗、五心烦热。舌红少苔及细数脉为阴虚内热之典型征象。\n治以滋阴降火、交通心肾，配合早睡和清润饮食，通常3周左右可见睡眠与盗汗改善。
zh.rationale: 盗汗、舌红少苔、脉细数三者一致指向阴虚火旺；失眠心烦提示心肾不交。
avoid: 辣椒与烧烤 - 耗阴助火
咖啡酒精 - 扰神伤阴
榴莲荔枝过量 - 助热
recipes: 百合银耳羹：干银耳10g、百合15g、冰糖少许，炖40分钟。
life: 晚上11点前入睡，避免熬夜
睡前泡脚并减少屏幕
保持室内湿润，多喝温水
points: 太溪 - 内踝后凹陷，按揉3分钟，滋肾阴
三阴交 - 内踝上三寸，按揉，养阴安神
神门 - 腕横纹小指侧，按揉助眠
exercise: 缓慢瑜伽或太极，每次20分钟
傍晚散步，避免大汗运动
zh.emotion: 保持心境平和，睡前可做腹式呼吸5分钟。
zh.dosage: 水煎服，每日一剂，分两次温服
warn: 持续高热或体重明显下降
zh.note: 盗汗伴持续低热请排除感染等疾病。
zh.fu_improve: 入睡较快，盗汗减少，口干缓解
zh.fu_next: 视舌脉变化调整滋阴药

en.mech: Depleted Kidney yin cannot restrain fire, so deficiency heat disturbs the Heart spirit, producing night sweats, insomnia and five-centre heat.
en.cause: Late nights, overwork, depletion after long illness.
en.cchar: Dry mouth and throat, hot palms and soles, night sweats, irritability.
en.ctend: Prone to insomnia, constipation and menopausal symptoms.
en.inquiry: For two weeks I have trouble falling asleep, sweat at night, have a dry mouth and warm palms, and feel irritable.
en.tongue: Red tongue with scanty coat, slightly thin body.
en.audio: Fast speech with a slightly hoarse voice.
en.summary: Kidney yin is insufficient and deficiency fire rises, causing insomnia, night sweats and heat in the palms and soles. The red, thinly coated tongue and thready rapid pulse are typical of yin-deficiency heat.\nTreatment nourishes yin, clears deficiency heat and reconnects the Heart and Kidney, with earlier bedtimes and moistening foods. Sleep and sweating usually improve in about 3 weeks.
en.rationale: Night sweats, a red tongue with little coat and a thready rapid pulse all point to yin deficiency with fire; insomnia with irritability suggests Heart-Kidney disharmony.
en.principle: Nourish yin, descend fire, harmonise Heart and Kidney
en.method: Enrich Kidney yin, clear deficiency heat, calm the spirit
good: Lily bulb - clears the Heart and calms the spirit
Goji berries - nourish Liver and Kidney
Duck - nourishes yin and clears heat
avoid: Chilli and grilled food - consume yin and feed fire
Coffee and alcohol - disturb spirit and injure yin
Durian and lychee in excess - add heat
recipes: Lily and white fungus soup: 10g dried white fungus and 15g lily bulb stewed 40 minutes with a little rock sugar.
life: Sleep before 11pm and avoid late nights
Warm foot soak and less screen time before bed
Keep the room humid and drink warm water
points: Taixi (KI3) - behind the inner ankle, press 3 minutes to nourish Kidney yin
Sanyinjiao (SP6) - above the inner ankle, press to nourish yin
Shenmen (HT7) - wrist crease on the little-finger side, press to aid sleep
exercise: Slow yoga or tai chi, 20 minutes
en.emotion: Keep a calm mind; try five minutes of abdominal breathing before sleep.
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Persistent high fever or marked weight loss
contra: Avoid spicy, drying and heating foods
en.note: Night sweats with persistent low fever should be checked for infection.
en.fu_improve: Falling asleep faster, fewer night sweats, less dry mouth
en.fu_next: Adjust yin-nourishing herbs to tongue and pulse changes

secondary: Jantung dan Buah Pinggang Tidak Harmoni
ms.mech: Yin Buah Pinggang berkurang tidak dapat mengawal api, lalu panas kosong mengganggu semangat Jantung, menyebabkan peluh malam dan tidak boleh tidur.
ms.cause: Berjaga malam, terlalu penat, kehabisan yin selepas sakit lama.
ms.cchar: Mulut dan tekak kering, tapak tangan dan kaki panas, peluh malam.
ms.ctend: Mudah insomnia, sembelit dan gejala putus haid.
ms.inquiry: Dua minggu sukar tidur, berpeluh waktu malam, mulut kering, tapak tangan panas dan mudah resah.
ms.tongue: Lidah merah, salutan sedikit, badan agak nipis.
ms.summary: Yin Buah Pinggang tidak mencukupi dan api kosong naik, menyebabkan insomnia, peluh malam dan panas di tapak tangan serta kaki. Lidah merah bersalutan nipis dan nadi halus laju ialah tanda yin kurang.\nRawatan menambah yin, menyejukkan panas kosong dan menyelaraskan Jantung dengan Buah Pinggang, bersama tidur awal dan makanan melembap. Tidur dan peluh biasanya bertambah baik dalam kira-kira 3 minggu.
ms.rationale: Peluh malam, lidah merah salutan sedikit dan nadi halus laju menunjukkan yin kurang dengan api; insomnia dan resah menunjukkan Jantung-Buah Pinggang tidak harmoni.
ms.principle: Tambah yin, turunkan api, selaraskan Jantung dan Buah Pinggang
ms.method: Subur yin Buah Pinggang, sejukkan panas kosong
good: Buah goji - menyuburkan Hati dan Buah Pinggang
avoid: Cili dan makanan bakar - menghabiskan yin
Kopi dan alkohol - mengganggu semangat
Durian dan laici berlebihan - menambah panas
recipes: Sup lili dan cendawan putih: 10g cendawan putih kering dan 15g lili, reneh 40 minit dengan sedikit gula batu.
life: Tidur sebelum 11 malam
Rendam kaki dan kurangkan skrin sebelum tidur
Kekalkan bilik lembap dan minum air suam
points: Taixi (KI3) - di belakang buku lali dalam, urut 3 minit
Sanyinjiao (SP6) - atas buku lali dalam, tekan untuk menambah yin
Shenmen (HT7) - lipatan pergelangan tangan, tekan untuk membantu tidur
exercise: Yoga perlahan atau tai chi 20 minit
ms.emotion: Kekalkan minda tenang; cuba pernafasan perut lima minit sebelum tidur.
ms.formula: Zhi Bai Di Huang Wan (diubah suai)
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Demam tinggi berterusan atau berat badan turun mendadak
ms.note: Peluh malam dengan demam ringan berterusan perlu disemak untuk jangkitan.
ms.fu_improve: Lebih cepat tidur, peluh malam berkurang, mulut kurang kering
ms.fu_next: Laras ubat menambah yin mengikut lidah dan nadi

zh.mech: 脾失健运，水湿聚而成痰，痰湿困阻中焦，故见身重困倦、体胖、痰多。
zh.cause: 嗜食肥甘厚味、久坐少动、湿气重的环境。
zh.cchar: 体型偏胖，腹部松软，面部油腻，身重易困。
zh.ctend: 易患高血脂、糖尿病、脂肪肝。
zh.inquiry: 体重近半年增加，总觉得身体沉重、头昏沉，早上痰多，饭后更想睡。
zh.summary: 患者以脾虚生痰、痰湿困阻为主要病机。体胖、痰多、舌胖苔腻与滑脉相互印证。\n治以健脾化痰、燥湿利水，配合控制饮食与规律运动，坚持4至6周可见体重与精神的改善。
zh.rationale: 身重困倦、舌胖苔白厚腻、脉滑皆为痰湿之象；饭后嗜睡提示脾运不足。
avoid: 肥甘油腻 - 助痰生湿
甜饮与糕点 - 碍脾生湿

en.mech: When the Spleen fails to transform fluids, dampness gathers into phlegm that obstructs the middle burner, leading to heaviness, weight gain and sputum.
en.cause: Rich and greasy diet, sedentary lifestyle, damp environment.
en.cchar: Heavier build, soft abdomen, oily face, heavy sleepy limbs.
en.ctend: Prone to high lipids, diabetes and fatty liver.
en.inquiry: I have gained weight over six months, my body feels heavy and my head foggy, lots of phlegm in the morning and sleepy after meals.
en.tongue: Enlarged tongue with a thick white greasy coat.
en.face: Oily sheen and slight puffiness of the eyelids.
en.summary: The main mechanism is Spleen deficiency generating phlegm, with phlegm-dampness trapping the middle burner. Weight gain, phlegm, an enlarged greasy tongue and a slippery pulse confirm each other.\nTreatment strengthens the Spleen, transforms phlegm and drains dampness together with diet control and regular exercise. Weight and energy typically improve after 4 to 6 weeks.
en.rationale: Heaviness, enlarged tongue with thick greasy coat and a slippery pulse indicate phlegm-damp; sleepiness after meals shows weak Spleen transformation.
en.principle: Fortify the Spleen, dry dampness, transform phlegm
en.method: Dry dampness, resolve phlegm, regulate Qi
good: Winter melon - clears heat and drains fluid
Tangerine peel - regulates Qi and resolves phlegm
avoid: Rich, greasy food - generates phlegm
Sweet drinks and pastries - burden the Spleen
Late-night snacks - overload digestion
recipes: Job's tears and adzuki soup: 30g each, simmered until soft, 3 times a week.
life: Reduce refined carbohydrates and sweets; stop at 70 percent full
Exercise to a light sweat daily
Keep the home dry and ventilated
points: Fenglong (ST40) - mid-shin outer side, press 3 minutes to resolve phlegm
Yinlingquan (SP9) - below the inner knee, drains dampness
Tianshu (ST25) - beside the navel, press to aid bowel movement
exercise: Jogging or swimming, 4 times a week for 40 minutes
en.emotion: Keep a relaxed mood and avoid stress eating.
en.formula: Er Chen Tang with Ping Wei San (modified)
en.purpose: Dries dampness, resolves phlegm, regulates Qi
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Rapid weight gain in a short time
en.note: Please also have blood lipids and glucose checked.
en.fu_improve: Weight loss, lighter body, less phlegm
en.fu_next: Adjust the strength of damp-draining herbs by weight and tongue coat

ms.mech: Apabila Limpa gagal mengubah cecair, kelembapan menjadi kahak yang menghalang pertengahan badan, menyebabkan badan berat, berat bertambah dan kahak banyak.
ms.cause: Diet berminyak dan manis, kurang bergerak, persekitaran lembap.
ms.cchar: Badan agak gemuk, perut lembut, muka berminyak, anggota berat dan mengantuk.
ms.ctend: Mudah kolesterol tinggi, kencing manis dan hati berlemak.
ms.inquiry: Berat badan naik sejak enam bulan, badan terasa berat dan kepala kabur, banyak kahak pagi dan mengantuk selepas makan.
ms.tongue: Lidah besar dengan salutan putih tebal berminyak.
ms.face: Muka berminyak dan kelopak mata agak bengkak.
ms.summary: Mekanisme utama ialah kekurangan Limpa menjana kahak, dan kahak-lembap menghalang pertengahan badan. Berat badan naik, kahak, lidah besar berminyak dan nadi licin saling mengesahkan.\nRawatan menguatkan Limpa, mengubah kahak dan menyingkir kelembapan bersama kawalan diet dan senaman tetap. Berat dan tenaga biasanya bertambah baik selepas 4 hingga 6 minggu.
ms.rationale: Badan berat, lidah besar bersalutan tebal dan nadi licin menunjukkan kahak-lembap; mengantuk selepas makan menunjukkan Limpa lemah.
ms.principle: Kuatkan Limpa, keringkan kelembapan, ubah kahak
good: Tembikai susu - menyejukkan dan mengalirkan air
avoid: Makanan berminyak - menjana kahak
Minuman manis dan kek - membebankan Limpa
Makan lewat malam - membebankan penghadaman
recipes: Sup barli Job dan kacang merah: 30g setiap satu, reneh sehingga lembut, 3 kali seminggu.
life: Kurangkan karbohidrat halus dan gula; berhenti makan pada 70 peratus kenyang
Bersenam sehingga sedikit berpeluh setiap hari
Pastikan rumah kering dan berudara
points: Fenglong (ST40) - tengah betis luar, urut 3 minit
Yinlingquan (SP9) - bawah lutut dalam
Tianshu (ST25) - tepi pusat, tekan membantu buang air besar
exercise: Joging atau berenang 4 kali seminggu, 40 minit
ms.emotion: Kekalkan suasana hati santai dan elak makan kerana tekanan.
ms.formula: Er Chen Tang dengan Ping Wei San (diubah suai)
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Dada sendat atau sesak nafas ketara
ms.note: Sila semak juga lipid darah dan glukosa.
ms.fu_improve: Berat turun, badan ringan, kahak berkurang

zh.mech: 湿邪与热邪相合，蕴结于中焦及肝胆，故见口苦黏腻、面部出油、痤疮、大便黏滞。
zh.cause: 嗜食辛辣油炸、饮酒、湿热气候。
zh.cchar: 面垢油光，易生痤疮，口苦口干，大便黏滞，小便短黄。
zh.ctend: 易患皮肤疾病、肝胆疾患、泌尿道炎症。
zh.inquiry: 脸上经常长痘，口苦口黏，大便黏马桶，身体沉重，小便偏黄。
zh.summary: 湿热蕴结中焦与肝胆为主要病机。痤疮红肿、口苦、大便黏滞与舌红苔黄腻、滑数脉互为佐证。\n治以清热利湿、健脾和中，配合清淡饮食，一般2至4周症状明显减轻。
zh.rationale: 口苦黏、便黏、舌红苔黄腻、脉滑数皆符合湿热；痘痘红肿为热毒外现。
zh.method: 清利肝胆湿热，运脾化浊
avoid: 辛辣油炸 - 助湿生热
酒类 - 湿热之源
甜腻奶茶 - 碍脾生湿
recipes: 绿豆薏米汤：绿豆30g、薏米30g，煮软，放凉饮用，每周3次。
life: 清淡饮食，戒酒
规律运动出汗以排湿
保持皮肤清洁，避免挤压痘痘

zh.emotion: 湿热者易烦躁，宜保持心境平和。

zh.note: 若有黄疸或右上腹疼痛请及时检查肝胆。
zh.fu_improve: 痘痘减少，口苦消失，大便畅通

en.mech: Dampness combines with heat and lodges in the middle burner and Liver-Gallbladder, producing a bitter sticky mouth, oily face, acne and sticky stools.
en.cause: Spicy and fried food, alcohol, hot humid climate.
en.cchar: Oily complexion, acne, bitter dry mouth, sticky stools, dark scanty urine.
en.ctend: Prone to skin disorders, hepatobiliary problems and urinary inflammation.
en.inquiry: Frequent acne on my face, bitter and sticky mouth, stools stick to the bowl, body feels heavy and urine is dark.
en.tongue: Red tongue with a thick yellow greasy coat.
en.face: Oily face with red swollen pimples.
en.audio: Loud voice with slight phlegm sound.
en.summary: The main mechanism is damp-heat accumulating in the middle burner and the Liver-Gallbladder. Red swollen acne, bitter taste and sticky stools match the red tongue with yellow greasy coat and a slippery rapid pulse.\nTreatment clears heat, drains dampness and supports the Spleen, with a light diet. Symptoms usually ease clearly within 2 to 4 weeks.
en.rationale: Bitter sticky mouth, sticky stools, a red tongue with yellow greasy coat and slippery rapid pulse all fit damp-heat; red acne shows heat toxin surfacing.
en.principle: Clear heat, drain dampness, fortify the Spleen
en.method: Clear Liver-Gallbladder damp-heat and transform turbidity
good: Mung beans - clear heat and toxin
Winter melon - drains fluid and clears heat
Job's tears - drain dampness and pus
avoid: Spicy and deep-fried food - feeds damp-heat
Alcohol - a source of damp-heat
Sweet milk tea - burdens the Spleen
recipes: Mung bean and Job's tears soup: 30g each, cooked soft and served cool, 3 times a week.
life: Eat light and stop alcohol
Exercise to sweat regularly to release dampness
Keep skin clean and do not squeeze acne
points: Quchi (LI11) - outer end of the elbow crease, press 3 minutes to clear heat
Yinlingquan (SP9) - inner lower leg, drains dampness
Neiting (ST44) - between the 2nd and 3rd toes, clears stomach fire
exercise: Swimming or jogging, 4 times a week
Yoga twists to promote release of dampness
en.emotion: Damp-heat types tend toward irritability; keep a calm state of mind.
en.formula: Yin Chen Hao Tang with San Ren Tang (modified)
en.purpose: Clears heat, drains dampness, resolves toxin
en.dosage: Decoct, one dose daily in two warm portions
warn: Persistent high fever or severe abdominal pain
en.note: If there is jaundice or right upper abdominal pain, have the liver and gallbladder checked promptly.
en.fu_improve: Fewer pimples, no bitter taste, smoother bowel movements
en.fu_next: After heat clears, switch to Spleen-strengthening care

ms.mech: Kelembapan bergabung dengan panas dan bertakung di pertengahan badan serta Hati-Pundi Hempedu, menyebabkan mulut pahit melekit, muka berminyak, jerawat dan najis melekit.
ms.cause: Makanan pedas dan goreng, alkohol, cuaca panas lembap.
ms.cchar: Muka berminyak, jerawat, mulut pahit, najis melekit, air kencing pekat.
ms.ctend: Mudah masalah kulit, hati-hempedu dan jangkitan saluran kencing.
ms.inquiry: Kerap berjerawat, mulut pahit dan melekit, najis melekit pada mangkuk, badan berat dan air kencing pekat.
ms.tongue: Lidah merah dengan salutan kuning tebal berminyak.
ms.face: Muka berminyak dengan jerawat merah bengkak.
ms.audio: Suara lantang dengan sedikit bunyi kahak.
ms.summary: Mekanisme utama ialah lembap-panas bertakung di pertengahan badan dan Hati-Pundi Hempedu. Jerawat merah bengkak, rasa pahit dan najis melekit sepadan dengan lidah merah salutan kuning berminyak serta nadi licin laju.\nRawatan menyejukkan panas, menyingkir kelembapan dan menyokong Limpa dengan diet ringan. Gejala biasanya reda dalam 2 hingga 4 minggu.
ms.rationale: Mulut pahit melekit, najis melekit, lidah merah salutan kuning dan nadi licin laju sesuai dengan lembap-panas.
ms.principle: Sejukkan panas, singkir kelembapan, kuatkan Limpa
good: Kacang hijau - menyejukkan dan menyah toksin
avoid: Makanan pedas dan goreng - memberi makan lembap-panas
Alkohol - punca lembap-panas
Teh susu manis - membebankan Limpa
recipes: Sup kacang hijau dan barli Job: 30g setiap satu, masak lembut dan hidang sejuk, 3 kali seminggu.
life: Makan ringan dan hentikan alkohol
Bersenam sehingga berpeluh
Jaga kebersihan kulit dan jangan picit jerawat
points: Quchi (LI11) - hujung luar lipatan siku, urut 3 minit
Yinlingquan (SP9) - betis dalam
Neiting (ST44) - antara jari kaki kedua dan ketiga
ms.emotion: Jenis lembap-panas mudah resah; kekalkan fikiran tenang.

ms.purpose: Menyejukkan panas, menyingkir kelembapan dan toksin
ms.dosage: Rebus, satu dos sehari dalam dua bahagian suam
warn: Demam tinggi berterusan atau sakit perut teruk
ms.note: Jika ada penyakit kuning atau sakit perut kanan atas, periksa hati dan hempedu segera.
ms.fu_improve: Jerawat berkurang, tiada rasa pahit, najis lancar
ms.fu_next: Selepas panas hilang, beralih kepada penjagaan menguatkan Limpa
